assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: premium whole-character hand-drawn 2D anime desktop fighting animation atlas, not pixel art and not chibi. Exactly SIXTEEN separate full-body figures in a STRICT regular FOUR COLUMNS BY FOUR ROWS on genuinely transparent alpha. Only TWO characters: Naruto occupies ALL eight cells in rows 1-2, Sasuke occupies ALL eight cells in rows 3-4. Each silhouette fully contained within its cell, including hair, toes, cloak or attached tail/wings. Wide generous transparent gaps so no silhouettes touch. Character identity, outfit and form consistent across its eight figures. Both face RIGHT in side / subtle three-quarter view. Beautiful polished anime ink outlines, dynamic correct anatomy, clear cel shading, expressive determined faces. They are fully clothed in every frame. Each character has the same EIGHT ordered poses: its first row left-to-right: (1) ready standing guard, (2) Naruto-style running forward leaning with arms behind, (3) punching windup fist pulled back, (4) fully extended right-hand punch with forward weight. Its second row: (5) forward high kick with leg fully extended, (6) sharp dodge/backstep with lowered head and bent knees, (7) chakra-charge crouch, dominant right hand pulled back beside hip, (8) explosive FORWARD JUTSU LUNGE with dominant right palm reaching forward at CHEST HEIGHT, arm extended to right. Naruto holds a small vivid BLUE spiraling Rasengan touching his right palm in poses 7 and 8; Sasuke has a small BLUE-WHITE lightning Chidori wrapped tightly around his right hand in poses 7 and 8. Any glow must stay joined to its hand silhouette, no detached sparks. NO text, labels, grid lines, background, floor, ground shadow, other characters, clones, detached objects or particles. Each cell exactly ONE connected alpha silhouette, all figures distinct rather than reused.
